title: General exact minimum-cover membership framework (even/odd r, disjoint and one-duplicate-row types) validated against both published membership outputs, then applied to the cost-12 parent 00000000000000003800000008002000 (23 rows)

candidate_roots.note: deterministic from the pinned inputs; all per-parent aggregates cross-checked against the published table

method: One bottom-up all-mask weighted matching DP over 2^r row masks gives every pm value used below. Even r: minimum covers are perfect matchings of pair roots. Odd r: covers are either (k-1 pairs + 1 singleton, disjoint) or (k pairs with exactly one doubly covered row); membership, joint membership and both totals are closed-form sums of pm table reads, with per-root A/B splits. Identities sum(A-parts)==k*A and sum(B-parts)==k*B plus the published-value reproductions on the 11-row and 18-row targets validate the framework before the 23-row run.

interpretation_guard: Cover-plan combinatorics only. Membership counts alternative minimum cover plans containing a root; it is not a search cost and implies nothing about WIN/REFUTED outcomes. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
